student_learning_goal: I can write my own code to do a task with sequence and loop.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can write my own code to do a task with sequence and loop.
header.character_watermark: Coda and Looper together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

parts.visual_layout: Top. Title slot and description line.

image_placeholders.description: A title slot 'My Project: ___' with a 1-line description below in B&W line-art. ~7in × 1in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_PROJECT_BOX: keywords (project, title) name what the box asks for.

parts.student_instructions: Write 4-8 steps of code. Use AT LEAST one loop.

image_placeholders.description: A code-writing area in B&W line-art, ~7in × 3in. 8 numbered code lines pre-printed. Header 'My Code:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_CODE_AREA: keywords (code) name what the area asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Must include at least 1 loop.

parts.student_instructions: Draw or describe what your code does.

image_placeholders.description: A blank drawing area in B&W line-art, ~7in × 2in. Pre-drawn 5x5 grid for movement codes OR blank space for shape/path codes. Header 'My Prediction:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_PREDICTION: keywords (prediction) name what the area asks for.

parts.student_instructions: After running your code with a partner, did it match your prediction? Yes or No. Why?
parts.visual_layout: Bottom. Yes/No bubble plus reasoning lines.

image_placeholders.description: A verification box in B&W line-art, ~7in × 1.5in. YES/NO oval bubbles plus 3 reasoning lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P4_VERIFY: keywords (match) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Children reflect on whether code matched.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and execute their code on the grid.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone summative worksheet. Use as integrated C3.1 + C3.2 evidence. Watch for loop-omission — flag for reteach if needed.
